shellNote: The sidebar, topbar, cards, buttons and status capsules are exported from src/ui/index.ts. The workbench and consumers compile the same source.

pageSamples.emptyNote: No design samples in this preview. Switch to Normal to restore the list.
pageSamples.errorNote: Sample failure only. Retry restores local records without contacting a service.
pageSamples.name: Sample name
pageSamples.dialogNote: Changes apply only to this in-memory design preview.

designProfile.title: Design profile editor
designProfile.note: Edit the current palette with the picker or six-digit HEX; switch modes explicitly. Preview updates without saving. Drafts stay local and are not public releases or restored automatically.
designProfile.invalid: Invalid field: {field}. Colors require #RRGGBB; dimensions require integers in the displayed ranges. Save and export are disabled.
designProfile.exportNote: Select and copy this JSON into a local file. Export still requires explicit engineering import; it does not update the public source.
designProfile.saved: Draft saved in this CU storage only. Public JSON/CSS unchanged.
designProfile.missing: No draft found. Public default applied.
designProfile.badDraft: Draft is damaged or unsupported. Public default applied.
designProfile.storageFailed: Storage operation failed. No save/delete success is claimed; restore/reset uses the public default.
designProfile.resetDone: Public default restored and this design draft removed. Theme/language preferences preserved.
designProfile.exported: Canonical JSON is ready to copy. Import it explicitly with the engineering command.
designProfile.liveNote: Valid profile · Live preview, no save required.
designProfile.unapplied: {field}: changes not applied. Showing the last valid profile; save/export disabled.
designProfile.secondary: Secondary sample controls · title, tone and compact card

uses.surface: Element Plus controls, base table surface and overlays; decorative card glass/background/shadows stay fixed.
uses.accent: Primary buttons, selected states and highlights.

designProfile.sharedNote: Source development only (pnpm dev / pnpm tauri dev). Apply writes the complete light/dark/shared profile to CU public JSON and generated CSS. Saving a draft is a separate action.

shared.connecting: Connecting to the local source-development channel…
shared.applying: Applying the submitted profile to public JSON/CSS…
shared.applied: Submitted profile applied to public JSON/CSS. CU and source consumers use the same shared styles; other hosts must refresh or rebuild their own output.
shared.unsupported: Source writing is unavailable in preview or packaged CU. Export JSON, then run pnpm design:profile --import /absolute/path/profile.json in the CU source directory.
shared.unavailable: Local development write channel unavailable. Export JSON for explicit CLI import, or refresh after starting CU with pnpm dev / pnpm tauri dev.
shared.protected: Local request protection rejected this apply. Export your edits, refresh the local CU development page and review before trying again.
shared.invalid_request: Request format rejected; public source unchanged. Export your edits and refresh before trying again.
shared.invalid_profile: Invalid profile rejected; public source unchanged. Correct the fields before applying.
shared.conflict: Public JSON/CSS changed outside this editor. Nothing was applied. Export your current edits first, refresh, review the new public default and then retry.
shared.io_failed: Source I/O failed; the two files may be partially updated. Export your edits, inspect both public targets, restore valid JSON if needed, run pnpm design:profile --generate and --check, then refresh.
shared.network_failed: Apply result could not be confirmed. Export your edits, inspect both public targets, run pnpm design:profile --check (restore valid JSON and --generate if needed), then refresh before retrying.
